title: review: LS-docs complete: bring task/T-1603 onto this branch and make the doc-pinned tests green
spec:
Replaces a fix round of T-1603 (fix rounds keep the parent's scope, and this needs two more files). Branch task/T-1603 holds 8d99483: CLAUDE.md steps 5 and 9 (compact in place, current-state plan.md) and the orchestrate and resume skills (skills/planner/*/SKILL.md; .claude/skills/* are symlinks to them). The gate is red on four doc-pinned tests:

1. First step, before any edit: fast-forward onto task/T-1603 (`git merge --ff-only task/T-1603`; this worktree is cut from goal/T-1590, an ancestor). Confirm `git log --oneline -2` shows 8d99483. If not a fast-forward, stop and report.
2. tests/test_goals.py::test_planner_md_matches_claude_md_lists: .orchestrator/prompts/planner.md mirrors the CLAUDE.md lists. Apply the same step 5 and step 9 text there.
3. tests/test_hooks.py::test_claude_md_has_150k_handover_rule pins the old '150k' rule. Rename it to test_claude_md_has_compact_in_place_rule and assert 'compacts in place' and 'handover_context_tokens' are in CLAUDE.md.
4. tests/test_skills_compaction.py::test_l2_tokens_not_higher_than_before and tests/test_skill_eval.py (Compaction group): skills/planner/orchestrate/SKILL.md went from 391 to 447 L2 tokens; it must be at most 391 again. Drop the acceptance-test-ID sentence from it, compress the plan.md sentence to about 'Overwrite plan.md (keep ## Now current; status lines go to .orchestrator/plan-log.md)', and trim other wording without losing a rule. Do not raise the token baseline.
Keep test methods inside their TestCase classes. Run tests/test_goals.py, tests/test_hooks.py, tests/test_skills_compaction.py and tests/test_skill_eval.py and commit.
acceptance: git log shows 8d99483 on this branch
grep -l 'plan-log.md' CLAUDE.md skills/planner/resume/SKILL.md skills/planner/orchestrate/SKILL.md lists all three files

result.summary: All six acceptance items look met. The new hooks test sits inside the SessionRules TestCase and asserts both required strings. planner.md matches the CLAUDE.md steps 5 and 9 text. plan-log.md appears in all three files. 8d99483 is in the log. I did not run the tests. The gate shows 1 attempt with 0 reds. The comments below are about guidance that was dropped; none of them break acceptance.

comments.issue: Step 5 lost the 'plan.md is current state only' wording. It no longer says '## Now' holds goal, next step and open human decisions, that plan.md stays under 10k chars, or that the auto-handover section goes last. T-1603 added these and the spec did not ask to remove them. planner.md was rewritten to match, so the loss is mirrored there.

Step 9 no longer mentions the launcher --autocompact flag or /compact from the terminal or Remote Control while the session is idle. A decision from 2026-10-03 records that /compact works from Remote Control. The doc no longer says how compaction is triggered. The same text was removed from planner.md.

The old rule not to read plan-log.md on resume, except to grep it for a missing fact, is gone. The new text says only that status lines are in plan-log.md. That no longer stops a resuming Planner from reading the whole log, which defeats the token savings the log split was meant to give.

The sentence on acceptance test ID format (tests/test_<module>.py::test_name, never File::Class::test) was dropped, as the spec instructed. Several gotchas in the evidence list failures from malformed IDs. That guidance should live somewhere that is not counted in the L2 tokens, such as the write-spec skill.
